title: MuddyWater Uses Microsoft Teams to Steal Credentials in False Flag Ransomware Attack
summary: The Iranian state-sponsored hacking group known as MuddyWater (aka Mango Sandstorm, Seedworm, and Static Kitten) has been attributed to a ransomware attack in what has been described as a "false flag" operation.
card_summary: The Iranian state-sponsored hacking group known as MuddyWater (aka Mango Sandstorm, Seedworm, and Static Kitten) has been attributed to a ransomware attack in what has been described as a "false flag" operation.

sections.context:
This aligns with ongoing ransomware campaigns targeting operational continuity and recovery readiness.

This reflects continued use of phishing as an initial-access path in broader intrusion chains.

email_summary: The Iranian state-sponsored hacking group known as MuddyWater (aka Mango Sandstorm, Seedworm, and Static Kitten) has been attributed to a ransomware attack in what has been described as a "false flag" operation. The attack, observed by Rapid7 in early 2026, has been found to leverage social engineering techniques via Microsoft Teams to initiate the infection sequence.
